title: PCOS Synthetic Equity Screener & Phenotype Model Guardrails
summary: A machine learning pipeline that addresses phenotype-based algorithmic bias in PCOS risk screening by generating synthetic clinical data for underrepresented Lean PCOS patients, applying clinical guardrails, and training a calibrated XGBoost classifier. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) to synthesize phenotype-balanced training rows.
